tracks.title: Saturday Jar
tracks.genre: Hawaiian slack-key and steel-guitar ballad (island pop, 1970s Gabby Pahinui lineage)
tracks.subject: a honey seller at a Saturday farmers' table who writes a new line on the label of one jar for the same woman every week, and she buys only one jar, so he has shelves of unsent lines at home

tracks.title: 最後の日に言えた一言
tracks.genre: Japanese 70s New Music folk-rock (Fukuoka four-piece band feel)
tracks.subject: A Japanese interpreter who has translated a visiting Thai engineer's every sentence for a week at a Hakata factory falls in love; on his last day he says one clumsy Japanese sentence that she does not have to translate
